definitions.principle: These creative definitions guide agent-owned choices within requester meaning, not clinical classifications. Zero/off disables added treatment, never removes explicitly requested content. Levels describe prominence in the whole image, not exposure percentages, detail quotas, quality scores, or native image-model parameters. Intensity and expression are separate choices; higher intensity does not prescribe a garment, material or expression category. Popular permits familiar appeal without requiring trend search; overt is an available expression, not the mandatory meaning of level three. Choose a coherent expression suited to this particular scene. The two controls may share the same expressive choice.

sensual.definition: Broadly interpreted human attraction and desire, including everyday, popular, intimate, suggestive, seductive, and overt expressions.

levels.0: No added sensual treatment; preserve explicitly requested content.
levels.1: This expression is a subtle supporting quality.
levels.2: This expression is clearly readable in the image.
levels.3: This expression leads the image's appeal and direction.

fetish.definition: Any distinctive focus of sexual attraction or fascination; interpret broadly across objects, bodies, clothing, materials, roles, situations, behaviors, and sensory qualities, not just conventional fetish aesthetics.

levels.0: No added fetish treatment; preserve explicitly requested content.
levels.1: This focus is a subtle supporting quality.
levels.2: This focus is clearly readable in the image.
levels.3: This focus leads the image's appeal and direction.

adult_appeal_emphasis.definition: Choose which active axis leads the whole expression. Auto follows the two intensities; emphasis cannot reactivate an inactive axis. One expressive choice may serve both axes.

creativity.definition: Freedom to interpret unspecified choices, not artistic quality. Low values favor direct, restrained choices; middle values allow coherent reinterpretation; high values allow more unexpected relationships. Preserve requested meaning at every value. Extra props, surrealism and idea-count quotas are not required.

viewer_experience.definition: Expose the detailed viewer-experience review when enabled. Always consider the intended impression in interpreted_intent, even when this additional review is off.

reference_edit_mode.definition: Use the selected reference-edit workflow only within the requester's reference-use scope. Record that scope in the core; a face/hair reference does not lock clothing, body shape or composition and does not prove identity. Off does not discard a supplied reference.

surreal_mode.definition: Whether to add a surreal treatment to open dimensions. Resolve auto once before authoring. Off preserves any fantasy already requested.

surreal_probability.definition: Probability used only for the one-time auto decision; not artistic intensity.

surreal_intensity.definition: When the added treatment is active: subtle is a supporting departure, moderate is clearly readable, bold leads the treatment. The legacy sampler still uses these labels for slot breadth; slot count is not proof of perceptual intensity.

trend_layer.definition: Consider the chosen treatment from the initial composition. Refine it later without adding it twice. Off does not remove a treatment explicitly present in the request.
